info.title: Oxly Plugin
info.description: Phase 6 discovery doc: Oxly MCP lives at /mcp (Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18) with 6 project-scoped read-only tools. REST auth stays on JWT; MCP auth uses the project ak_... key per tool call (DEMO_MODE=true allows keyless calls with explicit project_id). Phase 6 adds paged get_trace spans (span_limit/span_offset), blank-ID and negative-date rejection, Cache-Control (public, max-age=300) + X-Oxly-Plugin-Phase on discovery docs, and documented 429 rate-limit semantics. Superset of Phase 5.

post.description: JSON-RPC: initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list (6 tools), tools/call. Pass api_key (ak_...) on every call; optional project_id must match. List tools return total + limit/offset echo; get_trace pages spans via span_limit/span_offset (span_count is the true total, spans_truncated flags remaining pages). 429 means per-IP rate limit hit — honour retry_after.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded; body carries detail + retry_after (seconds).

ApiKeyAuth.description: Project scoping: api_key (ak_...) scopes to its project; optional project_id must match or the tool fails with `unknown project`. DEMO_MODE=true allows omitting api_key with an explicit project_id.

api_key.description: Project SDK key (ak_...). Omit only with DEMO_MODE=true + explicit project_id.

project_id.description: Optional; must match the key's project.

Pagination.description: Consistent Phase 5 pagination: total is the full result count; limit/offset are the clamped, echoed inputs.

count.description: Page size (kept on query_security_alerts for compat; equals len(alerts)).

SpanPagination.description: Phase 6 get_trace span paging: span_count is the true total; span_limit/span_offset are the clamped, echoed inputs; spans_truncated is true when spans remain beyond this page.

RateLimit.description: Phase 6 rate-limit semantics: MCP shares the API 100 req/min per-IP limiter; 429 bodies carry detail + retry_after (seconds).

CacheHeaders.description: Phase 6 discovery-doc caching: Cache-Control public, max-age=300 with X-Oxly-Plugin-Phase echo.

status.description: Case-insensitive; anything else fails with `unknown status`.

severity.description: Case-insensitive; anything else fails with `unknown severity`.

span_offset.description: Phase 6: span page offset (negative clamps to 0).

GetTraceArgs.description: Returns trace header (stable across pages) with spans in replay order for the requested page. span_count is the true total; spans_truncated flags remaining pages.

start_date.description: Unix seconds >= 0; must be <= end_date when both given.

ErrorModel.description: No cross-project oracle: bad key, mismatched project_id, and out-of-scope ids are indistinguishable by design.

unknown_trace.description: Blank id, id not found, OR id not in the key's project.

unknown_span.description: Blank id, id not found, OR id not in the key's project.

unknown_severity.description: severity must be low | medium | high | critical.

unknown_interval.description: interval must be hour | day | week.
